init.title: Xplora Kids Options

data.request_location: Ask watches for a fresh location on every poll

init.description: The default polling interval is intentionally gentle. Enabling fresh location requests may use more watch battery and more Xplora API calls. The cooldown applies to both the button and automatic fresh location requests. Optional MAC address fields can be used to merge Xplora devices with devices from router integrations such as FRITZ!Box Tools.
